CustomField.description: Returns true if today's date is between the Active From Date and Active To Date.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISNULL( ActiveFromDate )), NOT(ISNULL( ActiveToDate )), TODAY() >= ActiveFromDate , TODAY() <= ActiveToDate )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Returns true if today's date is between the Active From Date and Active To Date.
CustomField.label: Active
